name: Anthem of a Mother's Affection II

system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. The target recovers [[Recovery] + (SR x [POW mod])] HP during each Cleanup Process.

(Effect): While this [Harmony] is in effect, increase your [Hate] by +2 during the Cleanup Process of every round.

A support song that seals the wounds of allies by enveloping them in the warmth of a gentle hymn like a loving mother. Anyone who fights under this song will become an invincible hero.
